about: Hand-written facts about named construction schemes, from crawled developer, project and press pages (facts only: no text, images or tables copied; each fact with its URL and fetch date) and from the owner's CC0 photos of 4 October 2026. Joined to registry/sources/construction/sites.json by planning reference base. Crawls allowed for scoping (CLAUDE.md, cwplans exception, 2026-10-03); robots.txt checked for each host.
